title: Undo toast clears the tab bar
caption: On a phone the Undo toast only fades in, so it never slides over the tab bar. Shot at rest, so before and after match.

title: Level-up chip stays in the bar, 390
caption: 250 ms after Level up at Lv 27: the chip sits between the level and the button instead of floating off screen.

title: Level-up chip stays in the bar, 360
caption: Same at 360 px: the chip wraps to a small card and does not overlap the button.
